version.changelog: 自1.7.0以来累积更新至3.2：新增我的世界像素风风格；经典配色改革；全风格字体加粗定稿；默认风格两度演进（经典→活力→墨蓝手账）；新增适龄指引；文档按模块拆分；墨蓝手账增暖金装饰、六色层次

llm.summary: The skill is mostly a prompt-template guide, but some youth-facing anime style options are under-scoped and could steer educational outputs toward age-ambiguous or fetish-adjacent character imagery.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools include Read, Write, Edit, and AskUserQuestion, but the runtime instructions primarily describe reading the bundled reference files and producing prompts; no broad local data access, credential access, network use, or command execution is instructed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a markdown-only skill package with no executable scripts, package installer, network fetch, or hidden install behavior found in the inspected files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad aesthetic terms like pink style, anime, moe, Minecraft, pixel, maid outfit, and JK uniform, so the skill may activate outside a clear educational note-card request.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, privilege escalation, credential/session handling, or automatic mutation of user files was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose, generating educational notebook-style image prompts, is coherent, but styles.md adds character and costume prompts such as cat/animal-ear girls, maid outfits, JK uniforms, thigh-high socks, blushing, and small-girl motifs for low-grade or youth-oriented uses, which is not necessary for educational knowledge cards.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the anime and pink style presets, and prefer using the default notebook or other non-character styles for youth education. Review or remove the character/costume triggers and style elements if this will be used around children or in a classroom setting.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported by artifact text: the anime style expands beyond layout and educational visual design into detailed character, costume, accessory, and expression prompting that is not needed for note-card formatting.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Supported by artifact text: youth-facing style guidance includes maid outfits, JK uniforms, animal-ear girls, thigh-high/over-knee socks, lace, blushing, and small-girl motifs, creating a material content-safety concern despite no evidence of exfiltration or destructive behavior.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Supported by artifact text: the trigger metadata includes generic or standalone aesthetic terms that can match requests not clearly asking for this educational prompt generator.
